a11_f00e: Commander, we are all very sorry about General Carville.
The Soviets are using Crazy Ivans everywhere.
General Carville always said you could lead us to victory.
It seems you have proved him right.
Commander, Professor Einstein is on closed-circuit channel two.
Allow me to thank you, Commander.
Thank you for saving my home.
I have something, how shall I put it? A favor in return, yes?
You are familiar with my Chronosphere, yes?
The Chronosphere is a device that transports objects through space and time.
I have worked day and night for a very long time,
and finally found the best place to deploy this weapon.
There is just one small problem.
The perfect location is here,
on a small island off the Florida coast,
only a few kilometers from the Soviets' ally, Cuba.
Well, I must get back to work.
With that information, I can gather intelligence on Soviet nuclear weapons in the area.
They will pose the greatest threat to the Chronosphere.
Good luck, Commander.
a11_p01e: This message is for you, Commander, hiding away.
You can keep dancing, but you certainly will not be laughing.
It is time to surrender to the Soviet Union, Commander.
Once you taste my nuclear missiles, you will beg me for another chance.
a11_p02e: I warned you that we would destroy you, Commander.
Now this is your final warning...
Ah! Commander, your time is up!
You will not have long to wait.
a11_p03e: Commander, I thought I had seen everything,
Intelligence says the only effective counter is specially trained dolphins.
They are ready now, awaiting your orders.
